alpinejs-component

A playground you can open by hand, and the fixture the Playwright suite drives. Everything under Failure handling renders nothing and logs to the console on purpose.

On-page templates

Host scope reaches the component, including x-for.

Styling

This page is styled by a compiled Tailwind build, and the utilities on the card below are used only inside a component template. In v2 they could not reach that content without x-component-styles. This is issue #41.

Slots

Default, named, and unfilled slots. Slot content evaluates in the host scope, so owner resolves to the host's value even though the component declares its own.

Duplicate slot names

Both templates fill the one slot, in document order, like a native slot.

Dynamic source

Swapping the expression re-renders and destroys the previous tree. Slot content is re-projected each time, including after a component that has no slots at all.

Lifecycle events

Listeners sit on the wrapper, because the events bubble.

Light DOM wins

Every one of these was broken by the shadow boundary in v2.

from-host

Init and effect tracking

Counts initializations and effect runs, so double-initialization and effects leaking from an unmounted tree both become visible.

Failure handling

These render nothing on purpose. Expect console noise from this section.
